name: partially-targeted-module-reelection-scope
body: The module re-decide predicate requires a non-empty recorded file subtree, so a seeded Module whose module_file_subtrees entry is empty or absent is never re-decided through the module arm; a new or unknown module still enters via the missing-row arm, so this is not currently reachable as a defect. Upgrade only if an empty-subtree module must be re-decided.
